definitions: A protective garment worn over the front of one's clothes and tied at the back, used to keep the clothes clean while working.
A paved area at an airport, adjacent to a terminal or hangar, where aircraft are parked, unloaded, loaded, refuelled, and boarded.
A stage extension in front of the proscenium arch.
A piece of lead or other material used to cover a joint in a roof.
examples: She tied her apron before baking.
The aircraft taxied onto the apron.
The actors performed on the apron of the stage.
The plumber fixed the apron on the roof.
